description: Tab bar for switching between workbook sheets with add, delete, and rename support.

parameters.name: ActiveIndex
parameters.description: Zero-based index of the active sheet.

parameters.name: IsFormulaPointMode
parameters.description: Whether formula-point mode is active (tab click selects sheet for formula rather than switching view).

parameters.name: IsReadonly
parameters.description: When true, hides add/delete/rename controls (embedded/readonly view).

parameters.name: OnActiveSheetChanged
parameters.description: Called when the active sheet should change.

parameters.name: OnAddSheetRequested
parameters.description: Called when a new sheet should be added.

parameters.name: OnDeleteSheetRequested
parameters.description: Called when a sheet should be deleted.

parameters.name: OnRenameSheetRequested
parameters.description: Called when a sheet should be renamed.

parameters.name: OnSheetSelectedForFormula
parameters.description: Called when a tab is clicked in formula-point mode to switch the displayed sheet for ref selection.
